description: What a client says about itself is only a claim (QOR-0018). A client calling itself Settings or ARQADE is neither: it takes no name, icon or place of theirs and does not stand in when they are asked for. A client that opens a window and never draws takes no keys. On the lock screen no client has the keyboard, no controller unlocks, and nothing a device says appears. Run by ctest as prism_untrusted, through tools/dev/prism-products.py.

steps.log: Calling itself Settings: known as a client of its own, with no name of Prism's
Calling itself ARQADE: not a product, so the controller is not its, and the real ARQADE still starts
Settings asked for: Prism's own opens, and has the keyboard, whatever the clients call themselves
A window a client opens and never draws: unseen, and with no keys
Locked: a controller connected says nothing over the lock screen, and neither South nor Guide opens it
A password is what opens it, here a simulated session's; the question waits for that
With the controller interface on, locked again: South only offers the keyboard, and Guide does nothing
